<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple opening hours (model hours@1): the heading, a description, the address, the phone as a link, an
  optional map link and the opening hours as a list (the day or the days and the time per row). Axes: layout
  (columns: the address and the links at the start, the hours at the end from md up; stack: one narrow column,
  placed by the align setting), surface (plain, card: the address and the hours each on a card).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { OpeningHour } from "./hours-simple.types";

export type HoursSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  address: string;
  phone: string;
  phoneHref: string;
  mapLabel?: string;
  mapHref?: string;
  items: OpeningHour[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  layout?: "columns" | "stack";
  surface?: "plain" | "card";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  address,
  phone,
  phoneHref,
  mapLabel = "",
  mapHref = "",
  items,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  layout = "columns",
  surface = "plain",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<HoursSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const frame = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "stack" ? "flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-8"
  : "grid w-full grid-cols-1 gap-8 md:grid-cols-2"
);
const panel = computed(() =>
  (surface as string) === "card" ? "rounded bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground border border-border"
  : ""
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="hours-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack gap="12" align="stretch">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="cn('max-w-2xl', selfAlign)">
          <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Box :class="cn(frame, selfAlign)">
          <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="panel">
            <Text size="lg" weight="semibold" :class="textAlign">
              {{ address }}
            </Text>
            <LinkPlain :href="urlOf(phoneHref)" class="hover:text-primary">
              <Text size="lg" :class="textAlign">
                {{ phone }}
              </Text>
            </LinkPlain>
            <LinkPlain v-if="(mapLabel && mapHref)" :href="urlOf(mapHref)" class="hover:text-primary">
              <Text size="sm" :class="cn('text-primary', textAlign)">
                {{ mapLabel }}
              </Text>
            </LinkPlain>
          </Stack>
          <Box :class="panel">
            <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-2')">
              <ListItem v-for="h in items" :key="h.id" class="flex flex-row justify-between gap-4" data-slot="opening-hour">
                <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
                  {{ h.day }}
                </Text>
                <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                  {{ h.time }}
                </Text>
              </ListItem>
            </List>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
